passages.acid: In the Brønsted–Lowry model, an ac__ donates a proton to another substance.
passages.atom: An at__ consists of a nucleus surrounded by electrons.
passages.base: In the Brønsted–Lowry model, a ba__ accepts a proton from another substance.
passages.boiling-point: The boiling po___ is the temperature at which a liquid's vapor pressure equals the surrounding pressure.
passages.carbohydrate: Glucose is a car_________ that can serve as a source of energy.
passages.catalyst: A cat_____ increases a reaction's rate without being consumed overall in the reaction.
passages.compound: Water is a chemical com_____ containing hydrogen and oxygen in a fixed ratio.
passages.distillation: The mixture was separated by dis_________, using vaporization followed by condensation.
passages.element: A chemical ele____ contains atoms with the same number of protons.
passages.fatty-acid: A fatty ac__ contains a carboxyl group attached to a hydrocarbon chain.
passages.freezing-point: The freezing po___ is the temperature at which a liquid changes into a solid under specified conditions.
passages.melting-point: The melting po___ is the temperature at which a solid changes into a liquid under specified conditions.
passages.molecule: A water mol_____ contains two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.
passages.oxidation: The loss of electrons by a chemical species is called oxi______.

passages.solvent: Water acts as the sol____ when it dissolves the salt in the mixture.

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete ac__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：id → acid。学習語：acid。acidは「酸」。この定義では他の物質へプロトンを与える物質です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete at__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：om → atom。学習語：atom。atomは「原子」。原子核と、その周囲の電子から構成されます。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete ba__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：se → base。学習語：base。baseは「塩基」。この定義ではプロトンを受け取る物質です。酸と対になる用語です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete po___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：int → point。学習語：boiling point。boiling pointは「沸点」。液体の蒸気圧が周囲の圧力と等しくなる温度で、圧力に依存します。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete car_________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：bohydrate → carbohydrate。学習語：carbohydrate。carbohydrateは「炭水化物」。グルコースのような糖類を含む物質群です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete cat_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：alyst → catalyst。学習語：catalyst。catalystは「触媒」。反応を速め、反応全体では消費されない物質です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete com_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：pound → compound。学習語：compound。compoundは「化合物」。異なる元素が一定の割合で結合した物質です。混合物とは区別します。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete dis_________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：tillation → distillation。学習語：distillation。distillationは「蒸留」。蒸発させた成分を凝縮させ、成分の揮発性の違いで分離する操作です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete ele____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ment → element。学習語：element。elementは「元素」。原子核内の陽子数が同じ原子の種類を指します。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete ac__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：id → acid。学習語：fatty acid。fatty acidは「脂肪酸」。炭化水素の鎖とカルボキシ基を持つ物質です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete po___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：int → point。学習語：freezing point。freezing pointは「凝固点」。指定した条件で液体が固体へ変わる温度です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete po___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：int → point。学習語：melting point。melting pointは「融点」。指定した条件で固体が液体へ変わる温度です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete mol_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ecule → molecule。学習語：molecule。moleculeは「分子」。水では水素原子二つと酸素原子一つが結び付いています。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete oxi______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：dation → oxidation。学習語：oxidation。oxidationは「酸化」。電子を失うことという定義です。酸素との結合だけに限定しません。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete sol_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ution → solution。学習語：solution。solutionは化学の「溶液」。溶質が溶媒に均一に溶けた混合物です。

questions.prompt: Chemistry: complete sol____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：vent → solvent。学習語：solvent。solventは「溶媒」。塩を溶かす側の物質で、溶かされるsoluteと区別します。
